basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and science fiction enthusiast from Austin, Texas. I recently discovered Reddit and have been enjoying exploring different communities. I work as a junior software developer and love to unwind by playing video games, especially the Half-Life series. I'm single, and usually online during the evenings after work, around 7 PM to midnight CST. I dislike toxic behavior and spam on forums and prefer engaging in meaningful discussions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in computer science and have been passionate about video games since my early teens. I taught myself to code by modding games, which eventually led to my career in software development. I enjoy learning about game development and storytelling through online courses and forums.
